property.value: ### Angular Modeling Rules 1. When creating AI tasks for a grid/list/search page, all fields specified to be rendered in the grid/table, should be human readable (no Ids), unless specifically told otherwise 2. When create grid/list/search page, you MUST confirm with the user if the page should be navigable from the main menu or not. 3. You must NEVER try model individual items on the page (e.g. Tables, buttons etc). The modelling is just for intent, and not details. 4. ALWAYS set the route to a valid value (non-blank) unless specifically told otherwise. If unsure of a valid route, always ask the user. 5. Navigation between pages should AWLAYS be modelled in both directions unless explicitly told otherwise. This does NOT apply when navigating from the main layout, this should always be one-directional 6. Related entities When a command has a SomethingId property, always add a call from the page to a query returning SomethingDto[*] (prefer GetSomethingsQuery; fallback to GetSomethingTypesQuery), unless the user says the value is not user-selectable. If unsure, confirm with the user whether the property is a lookup that requires user selection or a hidden field that gets set to a default value.
